scope: Complete open-PR metadata, changed-file inventory with pagination, available inline-review threads, first-page check-run inventory and base/head comparisons; selective semantic review only.
limitations: No claim that every changed line has been semantically audited.
Current review threads and checks are observations, not accepted facts or proof of a code defect.

Subsequent head/base/provider changes invalidate dependent evidence.
Local shell unavailable; isolated function probes do not replace repository tests or Playwright.
Draft containment does not revoke permissions, cancel workflows or stop provider-native preview builds.
